scope: Indianapolis, Central Indiana, and Indiana resources relevant to the approved resource categories

records.name: INDYpendent Bytes
records.description: Coordinates regional food-system resources, production planning, cultivator pathways, buyer relationships, training, logistics coordination, surplus processing, and market visibility without taking ownership of produce.
records.notes: Founder-supplied authoritative organizational profile. Public website availability should be checked by the monitoring service.

records.name: Indiana 211
records.description: Statewide information and referral service connecting residents to health and human-service programs.
records.notes: Navigator, not a direct funder or service provider for every listed need.

records.name: Indiana FSSA Division of Family Resources
records.description: Administers Indiana public-benefit programs including SNAP, TANF, and health-coverage eligibility pathways.

records.name: Indiana Child Care Finder
records.description: Official Indiana search and information resource for locating regulated child-care providers.

records.name: Indiana Legal Services
records.description: Provides free civil legal assistance to eligible low-income Indiana residents.

records.name: Indiana Housing and Community Development Authority
records.description: Administers housing, homelessness, energy-assistance, and community-development programs in Indiana.

records.name: IndyGo
records.description: Public transportation provider for Indianapolis and Marion County, including fixed-route transit and mobility programs.

records.name: EmployIndy
records.description: Indianapolis workforce-development organization connecting residents and employers to training, employment, and career pathways.

records.name: WorkOne Central Indiana
records.description: Provides job-search, career, training, and employer services across Central Indiana.

records.name: Indiana Reentry Corporation
records.description: Maintains a vetted statewide resource navigator for housing, employment, legal assistance, education, food, documentation, and other reentry needs.
records.notes: Resource navigator; individual listed providers require separate verification.

records.name: Indianapolis Vet Center
records.description: Provides counseling, transition support, referrals, and connections to benefits, housing, employment, and community resources for eligible veterans and service members.

records.name: U.S. Small Business Administration Indiana District Office
records.description: Connects Indiana businesses to SBA funding programs, counseling, contracting certifications, disaster recovery, lenders, and partner organizations.

records.name: Indiana Small Business Development Center
records.description: Provides business advising, training, market research, capital-readiness support, and growth assistance to Indiana entrepreneurs and small businesses.

records.name: Indiana SSBCI Technical Assistance Program
records.description: Provides financial and accounting advising and training intended to help eligible Indiana small businesses prepare for and manage capital.
records.notes: Program availability and provider capacity should be checked before recommendation.

records.name: Indiana Technical Assistance Program (INTAP)
records.description: Annual Indiana program providing qualifying small businesses with professional and technical services for approved growth projects.
records.notes: Current project window and application status must be rechecked before recommendation.

records.name: Indiana APEX Accelerator
records.description: Provides counseling and information to help Indiana companies pursue local, state, and federal government contracting opportunities.
records.notes: Formerly commonly referenced as PTAC; canonical program naming should be monitored.

records.name: Indiana Grown
records.description: State program promoting Indiana-grown and Indiana-made products and connecting producers with consumers and market opportunities.

records.name: Purdue Extension Marion County
records.description: Provides local education and technical information in agriculture, horticulture, food, health, community development, and youth programming.

records.name: USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service Indiana
records.description: Provides agricultural conservation planning, technical assistance, and eligible financial-assistance programs to Indiana producers and landowners.
records.notes: Does not generally provide land itself; tagged for land stewardship and producer access support.

records.name: Indiana AgVets
records.description: Provides eligible veterans with agriculture-focused training, certification, internships, and individualized career preparation.
records.notes: Cohort dates and application availability require monitoring.

records.name: Central Indiana Community Foundation Nonprofit Resources
records.description: Provides nonprofit learning, connections, technical support, and access to grant opportunities administered through CICF and partner foundations.
records.notes: Individual grant rounds are time-limited and must be represented as separate opportunity records.

records.name: United Way of Central Indiana Capacity and Engagement
records.description: Offers training, accreditation, volunteer-engagement support, professional renewal, and other capacity-building resources for Central Indiana nonprofits.

records.name: Indy F.A.R.M.S Co-Operative
records.description: Indianapolis nonprofit providing agriculture, food, farm build-out, education, and home-maintenance services focused on seniors and community support.

records.name: Marion County Public Health Department
records.description: Provides and connects Marion County residents to public-health clinics, prevention programs, environmental health services, and community-health resources.

records.name: Indiana Nonprofit Resource Network
records.description: Provides workshops, board development, consulting, and resource referrals for Indiana nonprofit staff and volunteers.
